items.title: I built a static verifier for OpenCode to stop unsafe AI tool calls
items.raw_excerpt:
Erik Meijer wrote the paper "Guardians of the Agents" on formal verification for AI workflows, and Nada Amin implemented it in the Guardians repository. I built this plugin to bring static security verification to OpenCode. How It Works:
1. Interception: Uses OpenCode's TypeScript plugin system ("tool.execute.before") to intercept candidate tool calls (bash, read, edit, write) before they run.
2. Sidecar Verification: Passes tool parameters to a local Python daemon running guardians.verify().

excerpt_i18n.en: The MEDRGAG framework, through its knowledge organization process of "retrieval-completion-selection," integrates external retrieval and internal parametric knowledge to resolve the binary opposition of "retrieval deficiency and generation hallucination" in medical question answering. Author: Zhang Lu  Editor: Qi Chengyong                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The ACM
excerpt_i18n.es: El marco MEDRGAG, a través del proceso de organización de conocimiento de "recuperación-complemento-selección", fusiona la recuperación externa con el conocimiento paramétrico interno, resolviendo la dualidad de "falta de recuperación y alucinación generativa" en las preguntas y respuestas médicas. Autor: Zhang Lu. Editor: Qi Chengyong.

items.title: Will AI Bring Power to the People

title_i18n.es: ¿Traerá la IA poder a la gente?

excerpt_i18n.en: The article explores whether AI can truly empower ordinary people, discussing its potential to democratize knowledge and the risks of monopolization by tech giants.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 文章探讨人工智能技术能否真正惠及普通民众，分析AI在民主化知识、赋能个体方面的潜力与挑战。作者警告需警惕AI被少数巨头垄断的风险，强调开放与公平的重要性。

items.title: Big Firms Are Starting to Hire Again, Defying Predictions of AI Wipeout
items.raw_excerpt: Despite predictions of AI-driven job losses, big firms are starting to hire again, suggesting that the impact of AI on employment may be overstated.

title_i18n.en: Big Firms Are Starting to Hire Again, Defying Predictions of AI Wipeout
title_i18n.zh: 大型企业开始重新招聘，与AI导致岗位消失的预测相悖。
title_i18n.es: Las grandes empresas están empezando a contratar de nuevo, desafiando las predicciones de que la IA acabaría con los puestos de trabajo.

excerpt_i18n.en: Despite predictions of AI-driven job losses, big firms are starting to hire again, suggesting that the impact of AI on employment may be overstated.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 尽管有预测称人工智能将导致大规模失业，但大型企业近期开始重新招聘，打破了这一预期。这表明AI对就业市场的影响可能被夸大，企业仍在寻找人才以推动增长。
